method: built-in image_gen with three references; user-authorized finishing
style: Match EXACTLY the art style of the attached battle screenshot (the mockup): a bright cheerful cloud-top bubble world for an all-ages mobile casual game, clean colored dark outlines, soft controlled cel shading, bright glossy highlights, juicy saturated colors, rounded capsule-and-glass user interface. Strictly original: no plants, flowers, vegetables, flowerpots, fences, dragons or dinosaurs, nothing resembling any existing game's characters, interface or logos.
base_prompt:
Match EXACTLY the art style of the attached battle screenshot (the mockup): a bright cheerful cloud-top bubble world for an all-ages mobile casual game, clean colored dark outlines, soft controlled cel shading, bright glossy highlights, juicy saturated colors, rounded capsule-and-glass user interface. Strictly original: no plants, flowers, vegetables, flowerpots, fences, dragons or dinosaurs, nothing resembling any existing game's characters, interface or logos.

A single wide game layer, transparent background: the soft "stage" that sits in the lower part of the battle screen, behind the deployment pads and the four queue tubes, exactly like the area below the foam rail in the attached mockup (first image). 1080x772, landscape.
Content: a large calm muted blue-gray frosted panel (soft gray-blue, about #B4C8E0 at the top fading to about #9DB4D2 at the bottom), slightly translucent, filling almost the whole width; its top edge is a soft gently rounded line with a faint white rim; its LEFT, RIGHT and BOTTOM edges are framed by puffy white-and-pale-blue clouds that overlap the panel edges, with a few small glossy colored bubbles (pink, blue, yellow, purple) and one small rainbow arc tucked into the bottom corners, like the mockup.
The middle of the panel must stay PLAIN and evenly lit: no clouds, objects, patterns or text in the central 80% of the width between 5% and 88% of the height, because pads, creatures, glass tubes, numbers and three buttons are drawn on top of it.
The top 3% of the image is transparent (the foam rail sits there). No characters, no pads, no tubes, no buttons, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
production_notes: Production layout notes: The first reference is the exact cloud-and-bubble art direction, especially below its foam rail. The second reference is only placement and what the existing flat slab must replace, not its schematic rendering. The third is the existing background behind this new separate layer: do not recreate that sky or castle inside the panel. Render ONLY this stage asset with real alpha transparency, not a game screenshot. At final 1080x772: rows 0–23 must be fully transparent; the faint rounded top rim fits in rows 24–38. The entire rectangle x=108–971, y=39–679 is a completely calm, uninterrupted frosted blue-gray surface with only a very subtle smooth vertical color transition. No clouds, bubbles, rim highlights, rainbow, decorative marks, texture or framing inside this protected rectangle. Keep all side clouds and colored bubbles within the outermost 9% left/right strips; bottom cloud puffs and one SMALL rainbow arc stay below y=690. Make the frosted panel itself broad and nearly full-width, flat front-on with no perspective tilt. No inner ledge, no dividing line, no center glare, no big vignette. Few glossy pink/blue/yellow/purple bubbles only at outer/bottom corners. Outside the silhouette is alpha-transparent. No shadow. Preserve the two specified panel colors #B4C8E0 and #9DB4D2. Output target 1080x772 landscape.

self_check.name: 尺寸、文件名和透明边缘

self_check.name: 画风与参考
self_check.reason: 使用所列三张参考；云朵、圆泡泡、轻微玻璃高光沿用示意图，灰蓝底面与交付背景叠加已目检。实机截图仅作为布局参考。

self_check.name: 角色身体主色ΔE76
self_check.reason: 无角色身体。托板颜色另按第56项检验：上部(540,39)为#B4C8E0，下部(540,679)为#9DB4D2。

self_check.name: 空心半透明弹体
self_check.reason: 此文件不是弹体；磨砂面统一Alpha=230/255，属于轻微半透明面板。

self_check.name: 文字和数字

self_check.name: 禁止元素
self_check.reason: 未见植物、蔬菜、花盆、篱笆、恐龙、既有游戏标志；没有旧版本的星形装饰和绿色泡泡。

self_check.name: 九宫格

self_check.name: 多帧特效和可染色灰度
self_check.reason: 本文件为单张彩色场景层，没有帧切分或程序染色要求。

self_check.name: 中央80%宽、5%–88%高留白
self_check.reason: 保护区为x=108–971、y=39–679（右下边界采用排他区间[108,39,972,680)）。目检无云、泡泡、彩虹、图案和文字；同一行RGB任一通道的最大差值仅1/255，只有平缓纵向渐变；保护区Alpha恒为230。

self_check.name: 顶部3%透明
self_check.reason: 顶部24行（y=0–23）全部RGBA=0，覆盖3%×772=23.16px；微白顶沿位于保护区上方。

self_check.name: 边饰分布和底色
self_check.reason: 白/浅蓝云仅沿左右及底部，粉、蓝、黄、紫圆泡泡位于边缘，一个小彩虹收在左下角；颜色与中央留白已按最终图检查。
